title: Solar-complemented moisture electric generator for synergistic energy harvesting in all regions
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01476C, Paper
Gangli Zhao, Daozhi Shen, Shuaiqi Han, Dingyun Zhang, Linglan Guo, Qiaolin Gu, Feng Zhan, Limin Zhu
This solar-complemented moisture electric generator synergistically harvests ambient humidity and sunlight, delivering stable power output across diverse climates for self-powered wearable and IoT systems.
